requirements: Aimed at vendors of enterprise/B2B software - SelectHub is a software selection and comparison platform for buyers
Vendors claim an existing product profile (or create one) via the 'claim your product' portal
Claiming the product profile is free; SelectHub separately sells vendor programs (Analyst Program, enhanced profiles, MQL/HQL lead generation)
preparation: Product name and product website URL
Work email matching the vendor domain (claim flows typically verify vendor affiliation - verify on the claim form)
Short product description, category fit, and positioning
Logo and product collateral if the claim form requests assets
workflow: Search/claim your product profile and complete the vendor claim form
Verify vendor affiliation as instructed (exact mechanism not public - likely email domain check)
Once approved, maintain the product profile so it surfaces when buyers' requirements match
watchFor: The claim page returned HTTP 403 to automated fetch - complete in a real browser
Strong upsell environment: SelectHub's Seller Programs (analyst engagement, enhanced profiles, lead-gen MQLs/HQLs) are the paid layer - a free claim does not include them
Inbound contact from SelectHub sales after claiming is likely; budget expectation accordingly
SelectHub matches products to buyers via its selection platform - an incomplete profile may never surface in comparisons
countsAsLive: The product has a public profile page on selecthub.com and appears in the relevant software category for buyer comparisons
unknowns: Exact claim-verification mechanism (the claim page did not render publicly)
Whether products not already in SelectHub's database can be submitted cold, or only claimed
Whether the outbound vendor link is follow or nofollow (one third-party source says nofollow)
